cells.quote: Similarly, for the PI, the indirect effect for all the three pathways were signiﬁcant. The effect value is 0.18 for indirect path1 (95%CI: (0.00–0.33]), 0.09 for indirect path 2 (95% CI: [0.02 –0.16]), and 0.02 for indirect path 3 (95% CI: (0.00–0.06]).
cells.note: The pathways link math anxiety, task-difficulty sensitivity, posterior-insula activity, and math avoidance; this is a mediation analysis rather than a randomized intervention.
